Attached is our project proposal and a short budget justification. We are a registered non-profit (certificate attached in the proposal) and hopeful Redwood may be able to provide promotional credits or a trial extension to cover the pilot. Any eligibility criteria we need to meet?

Appreciate any guidance — we can be flexible with timing.
